title: GAIN — Flash Loan-Based skim/sync Reserve Manipulation Analysis
root_cause: Repeated use of `skim()` and `sync()` on the Uniswap V2 pair to desynchronize pair reserves, then profiting via a swap
steps: → [1] Uniswap V3 flash: flash loan 0.1 WETH
→ [4] Call skim() — extract excess GAIN tokens
→ [5] Call sync() — update reserves to lower actual balance
→ [6] Repeat cycle to amplify reserve-balance mismatch
→ [7] Final swap() to extract remaining WETH
